title: Steinman fired by Lockheed after his book

plain: A man named Bill Steinman was fired by Lockheed, a large American aircraft company, a couple of days after his book on flying saucers came out. According to Scott Ramsey, a researcher who studies a reported crash of alien craft, Steinman had been warned beforehand that the company did not like its employees writing books on flying saucers. Ramsey repeats what Steinman told him, and tells it as a sign of how unwelcome the subject was.
